product.name: AI Music Production System
product.purpose: Turn a simple music idea into listenable, editable/reviewable, exportable music with provenance and replayable evidence.

five_why.question: Why build the system?
five_why.answer: A prompt alone is not a production workflow; the user needs an auditable path to playable output.

five_why.question: Why require project/evidence storage?
five_why.answer: Without provenance and frozen output hashes, a generated track cannot be reproduced or reviewed.

five_why.question: Why fail closed on providers/licenses?
five_why.answer: Unidentified model/provider/license state can make output legally or operationally unusable.

five_why.question: Why require real audio and GUI evidence?
five_why.answer: A UI or text plan without audible bytes is not a music-production result.

five_why.question: Why preserve gaps instead of simulating AI-provider success?
five_why.answer: A procedural local synthesizer is not evidence that an external AI model/provider chain works.

risk_boundaries.copyright_and_license: No external samples/models are bundled in the local procedural path. Any future external model/provider must record identity, terms, request provenance and output policy before qualification.
risk_boundaries.source_recovery: Historical candidate identity is preserved, but missing source/build lineage is never inherited by the re-authored implementation.
risk_boundaries.updater: Positive production update remains blocked until an independent repository, release manifest, trusted signing key, rollback and real N->N+1 evidence exist.
risk_boundaries.user_data: Repair and update must never silently delete user projects.
risk_boundaries.claims: Local procedural generation may be described as generated audio, not as proof of an external AI model.

domain.audio_contract: PCM WAV, deterministic for same prompt+seed+version, non-silent, hashed
domain.evidence_contract: Every generated master records prompt hash, seed, provider, WAV SHA-256 and project SHA-256.

interfaces.netclient: network_probe(https_url)->PASS/FAIL with status, bytes, payload hash and bounded retries
interfaces.updater: independent AIMusicUpdater.exe; missing production context => BLOCKED rc=3

success_criteria.engineering_final: All frozen hard gates literal PASS in independent repository, including positive updater N->N+1 and formal release re-download Same Hash.
success_criteria.business_final: Full recovered music-production scope qualified with real audio, provider/model/license evidence where used, output integrity, review/edit flow and counterexample/reversal evidence.
success_criteria.final_gate: engineering=100 AND business=100 AND all hard gates PASS
